body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Optoma launched its new feature-rich digital projectors for the professional installation market.

The latest TX-series from Optoma all have high brightness levels, as well as a DarkChip3™ DLP® chipset and the latest color processing/scaling technologies from Texas Instruments for incredible image quality. These heavyweight projectors offer versatility and deliver performance for professional video applications.
Combining functionality and versatility, the TX776 and TX782 digital projectors are designed for large and demanding environments – ideal for the professional installation industry.
All three projectors feature native XGA resolution, super bright lumens levels, a multitude of connections including HDMI, DVI w/HDCP, VGA-In/Out, S-Video, Composite and +12V Trigger.
These solid projectors deliver higher the flexibility installers look for to produce all-around projection solutions.
